describes.definition: SOURCE gives an account of the complete subject or phenomenon TARGET, without asserting causation, subtype or parthood.

stores.definition: SOURCE holds, retains, or performs storage of TARGET. TARGET is the stored content, not its destination. Explicit occurrence qualifiers specify storage format, medium or conditions.

is_a.definition: SOURCE is a subtype or kind of TARGET, not a component or instance.

has_subtype.definition: TARGET is a subtype or kind of SOURCE, not a component or instance.

part_of.definition: SOURCE is a structural component of TARGET, not merely located there or participating in it.

contains.definition: SOURCE spatially contains TARGET; structural parthood and ownership are not implied.

contained_in.definition: SOURCE is spatially contained in TARGET; structural parthood and ownership are not implied.

causes.definition: SOURCE causally produces the explicit event TARGET, not merely permitting it. TARGET names the action or change, not its affected object.

caused_by.definition: The explicit event SOURCE is causally produced by TARGET. SOURCE names the action or change, not its affected object.

acts_on.definition: The event SOURCE acts on or changes the state, position, or availability of the object TARGET; TARGET is not another event or process.

inhibits.definition: SOURCE reduces or suppresses the occurrence or activity of TARGET.

associated_with.definition: SOURCE and TARGET are associated; no causality, parthood or direction is asserted.

has_participant.definition: The entity TARGET participates in the event or process SOURCE, without being its structural part.

precedes.definition: SOURCE happens temporally before TARGET, without implying causation.

follows.definition: SOURCE happens temporally after TARGET, without implying causation.

sibling_of.definition: SOURCE and TARGET are distinct peers under an explicitly justified common parent and the same parent relation.

requires_understanding_of.definition: Understanding SOURCE requires prior understanding of TARGET; this is a learning prerequisite, not causality.

defines.definition: TARGET is the defining description of SOURCE, not a function, participant or mere associated concept.
